title: Lady and the Tramp
tagline: One plate. One strand. One meatball.
about: A pampered cocker spaniel falls for a streetwise stray who shows her life outside the yard.
cue: Serve the mains when Tony brings out the spaghetti at the back of the restaurant.
faces: Spaghetti every night. The best table is out back.
Out back, by the barrels. One plate, one candle.
Regulars at the back door eat free
Italian loaf, parsley butter, parmesan, baked crisp at the edges.
Salami, provolone, olives, artichoke hearts, roasted red peppers, torn bread.
Long and salted, in a crock on every table.
Beef and pork meatballs, slow tomato and basil. Save the last meatball for your sweetheart.
Back door, by the barrels. Candle lit.
The fine houses up the hill. Every one has a dog that knows our back door.
Wear on the collar at all times
Beans, greens, little pasta, tomato broth.
Cherry, pistachio and chocolate ice cream.
Pressed lemons, cold from the ice box.
Dark roast, a twist of peel.
A tall glass, or a saucer.
Every night my friend comes round the back for his supper. Tonight he brings a lady. Joe, the candle!
Prices subject to change. Telephone Main 1909. Form T-55.
No muzzles out back. No cats, not even two.
